title: Why Adamantium Transfers More Damage Than Vibranium
full_script_text: This is Adamantium. This is Vibranium. So what's the difference? You might think they absorb impacts identically. Not even close. Adamantium has unyielding atomic bonds. It never breaks, but redirects raw kinetic shock directly into your bones. Vibranium absorbs kinetic shockwaves into its lattice, storing energy until reaching a violent saturation limit. Adamantium resists pure physical force, while Vibranium cancels kinetic energy. Next is Beskar vs Mithril. Follow so you don't miss it.
final_rule_outro: Adamantium resists pure physical force, while Vibranium cancels kinetic energy.
stickman_visual: Stickman referee standing between a sharp silver metallic skeleton icon labeled 'ADAMANTIUM' and a glowing purple metallic shield labeled 'VIBRANIUM' on a pure white screen.
